name: MindMeister
description_en:
MindMeister is an online visual thinking and collaboration tool built around connected topics. Its editor provides map, outline and focus views, with comments, notes, attachments and sharing controls.

This profile uses readable official help articles because the homepage and a separate price page returned 403. The help documents establish concrete plan restrictions and a recent sharing change; paid cash rates remain unknown.
description_zh:
MindMeister 是围绕相连主题的在线可视思考与协作工具，编辑器提供脑图、大纲和专注视图，以及评论、笔记、附件和分享控制。

首页及另一价格页返回 403，因此本文采用可读官方帮助。文档可以确认具体套餐限制和近期分享变化，付费现金价格仍未知。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

sections.en: The official editor guide describes topic styling and connections, notes and comments, layout changes, collaborators and map/outline/focus navigation. Collaboration access and file export are separate permissions. An editor displaying an export control does not mean that the current user or plan can use it.
sections.zh: 官方编辑器指南介绍主题样式及连接、笔记评论、布局修改、协作者和脑图、大纲、专注导航。协作访问与文件导出是不同权限，界面出现导出控件，不代表当前用户或套餐可用。

sections.title_en: Example: review a release scope with a collaborator
sections.title_zh: 示例：与协作者审核发布范围
sections.en: Create branches for scope, open questions and risks, then invite a reviewer to that map. Ask them to comment on one disputed item and check their actual access before sharing sensitive material. If an export is needed, open the exported file in the intended destination and inspect omitted content. This is a proposed workflow; no account, invitation or export was executed.
sections.zh: 创建范围、未决问题及风险分支，再邀请审核者访问该图，请其评论一个争议项目。分享敏感材料前，先检查实际访问权。需要导出时，应在目标工具重开并核对遗漏内容。本例是建议流程，未创建账户、邀请或导出。

sections.title_zh: 2026 年十月的脑图访问变化
sections.en: The official change notice states that on October 14, 2026 team maps become private and invite-based; previous team membership alone does not preserve access. Basic now allows three maps per person, including maps shared with that person. It retains access to the three oldest maps; excess maps become inaccessible rather than deleted. Owners can share a missing map again. Paid users avoid the map-count cap but still need explicit access after the team-map change. This is the dated documented rule, not an account migration tested here.
sections.zh: 官方变更说明写明，2026 年 10 月 14 日团队图转为私有邀请制，原团队成员身份本身不保留访问权。Basic 现为每人三张，别人分享的图也计入，保留可访问的是最早创建的三张；超额图不能访问，但未删除。所有者可重新分享缺失的图。付费用户不受图数限制，但团队图变化后仍需明确访问。本段是带日期的文档规则，并非实测账户迁移。

sections.title_zh: 导出需付费，格式权益有差异
sections.en: The export guide excludes Basic and view-only users from file export. Personal/Pro/Business permit file exports; Word/PowerPoint require Pro or Business and bulk export requires Business. Markdown can represent a map as Mermaid or an indented list, but omits images and attachments. It is therefore not a complete media backup. Confirm the desired format and restore workflow before making export a contractual requirement.
sections.zh: 导出指南排除 Basic 和仅查看用户。Personal、Pro、Business 可导出文件；Word/PowerPoint 需 Pro 或 Business，批量导出需 Business。Markdown 可表示为 Mermaid 或缩进清单，但不含图片和附件，因此不是完整媒体备份。将导出作为合同要求前，应确认目标格式及恢复流程。

sections.title_en: Known free restrictions, unknown paid amounts
sections.title_zh: 已知免费限制，未知付费金额
sections.en: The help pages identify the free Basic tier and paid tier names, but the requested standalone price page returned 403. No earlier directory rate is retained as current. Choose a plan by map access and export requirements, then verify currency, billing period, seats, AI usage and renewal at an accessible official checkout. Self-hosting, software license terms, contractual retention and restoration remain unverified.
sections.zh: 帮助页确认免费 Basic 及付费版本名称，但请求的独立价格页返回 403，本文不把旧目录金额当当前价格。应按脑图访问及导出要求选版，再在可访问官方结账确认币种、周期、席位、AI 用量和续费。自托管、软件许可、合同保留及恢复仍未核实。
